scheme_name: Goa Village & Municipal Child Committee Grants And Awards Scheme
other_conditions: The applicant must be a Panchayat or a Municipal local body in Goa.
The local body must have established a Village or Municipal Child Committee as prescribed under Rule 7 of The Goa Children’s Homes Rules, 2004.
The Committee must have met at least once in the three months prior to the application submission.
The Committee must have met to discuss and resolve issues relating to children within the jurisdiction of the local body.
The local body must provide space for the Committee sittings in its premises.
The proposal must be signed by the Secretary (for Village Panchayat) or the Chief Executive (for Municipality) along with the resolution of the respective body.
For Village Panchayat proposals, a recommendation by the concerned Block Development Officer is required.
The application must be submitted within six months from the commencement of the financial year.
benefits_summary: An annual grant of ₹10,000 is provided to the local body for administrative expenses, disbursed in a single electronic transfer within three months.
documents_required: Supporting documents showing the activities of the Child Committee of the local body
Resolution of the Panchayat or Municipal body
Recommendation by the Block Development Officer (for Village Panchayat proposals)
